verdict.rationale: Tilled has a documented public REST API confirmed live by a runtime probe (structured error response validating header contract before auth), with docs covering payments, webhooks, disputes, merchant onboarding, and testing/sandbox. missing for 10: no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index, no independent third-party corroboration of API completeness, and no evidence of official SDKs/agent tooling beyond raw REST docs.
